product_summary: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. (founded 1935) is a phytochemical / botanical-API manufacturer: 3 manufacturing sites in India, offices in India, Europe, Hong Kong and USA; states 90% of production is exported to 35+ countries (source: https://www.alcheminternational.com/about-us/). Published product list (https://www.alcheminternational.com/pharmaceutical-actives/) is entirely single-molecule plant-derived APIs with CEP/USDMF dossiers: thiocolchicoside, colchicine, atropine sulfate, hyoscine butylbromide, digoxin and digoxin micronised, enoxolone, nicotine, nicotine ditartrate dihydrate, nicotine polacrilex/resinate. Separate divisions: PhytoAdvance (botanical extracts), EpiQue (finished healthcare/cosmetic products for the Indian market), Epique Nicotine (e-cigarette nicotine). No petrochemical, oil & gas or industrial chemical products found anywhere on the site.
comment: HS 2939.79 is CORRECT and well corroborated: atropine sulfate, hyoscine butylbromide, nicotine and its salts/resinate, colchicine and thiocolchicoside are all single alkaloids of heading 2939 (source: product pages under /pharmaceutical-actives/, each with CEP/USDMF numbers). HS 2938.90 is only PARTIALLY correct: digoxin is a cardiac glycoside of 2938.90, but enoxolone (glycyrrhetinic acid) is a triterpenoid aglycone and is more properly 2918.29/2938.90 borderline — cannot be resolved from the site alone. Two declared-code issues: (1) the declaration omits the botanical-extract line (PhytoAdvance) which, if sold as extracts/gums, would fall in 1302.19 rather than 2938/2939 — this is a product line missing from the declaration; (2) the EpiQue finished cosmetic/healthcare goods and the Epique Nicotine e-cigarette line are finished consumer products (Ch. 33 / 2404.11) and are not covered by the declared API codes at all. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a pharma/fine-chemical (phytochemical API) producer with no oil & gas activity on record. Legal-name discrepancy: claimed 'ALCHEM INTERNATIONAL LIMITED' vs site 'Alchem International Pvt. Ltd.' — the site consistently uses the private-limited form; the 'Limited' variant is not corroborated by the company's own website. All product/HS mapping above is from the company's own catalogue and CEP/DMF references — no customs line was available to me, so actual shipment-level HS usage is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancies are not grounds for rejection: company retained, codes to be corrected/extended to 2939.79, 2938.90, 1302.19 and 2404.11/33 as applicable.
